$comment: The store-review open set: the only URLs the site serves without the preview password while
the review-open switch is ON. The switch is OFF by default; deploy-site.sh --review-open turns
it on for one deploy. scripts/review-open.mjs reads this file in the image build and writes the
nginx maps; scripts/crawl-review-open.mjs reads the same file (and the build's resolved set) to
prove every entry answers and everything else stays walled.
Kinds:
page      a self-contained render from scripts/build-public-legal.mjs (no /_next/ chunk, no
asset). `url` and `url/` both serve `file`; any query string is ignored.
prefix    every path under `url` serves `file` (the promise share link /p/<anything>).
redirect  301 to `to`, which must itself be in this set.
next      a page of the Next export, opened together with exactly the files its own HTML, its
stylesheets and its own script chunks load (resolved at build time). Its links to
walled pages stay walled.
file      one static file from the export, served as-is.
alias     `url` serves another export file `file` (an asset, never a page).
Already public in every mode, and not repeated here (nginx.conf carries them): /privacy,
/terms, /home, /daemon and /.well-known/ (assetlinks.json, apple-app-site-association,
provian-app-version.json). /.well-known/mcp-registry-auth stays walled in both modes.
`source` names what opens or lists the URL: app code (non-test), a store record, or the page
that links it.
